
=================================================================
#28 Forty Fortresses  (642)
Arc: Iron Will · place: surabol · tone: war-legend chronicle
Logline: In Baekje’s markets they spit when they say his title. They add, quietly, that Gyebek hasn’t met him yet.
=================================================================
[0] ¶ Baekje took forty Silla fortresses in one autumn. Silla’s answer reaches Sabi at breakfast.
[1] King Euija: I-i-it’s Kim Yushin!!
[2] King Euija: You’ve never heard of Kim Yushin…?
[3] King Euija: You fool — Kim Yushin is the Greatest Blade of Samhan…! / Yeon Gesomun, General Gyebek — tell them all to stand aside. Or tell Gyebek the title is still disputed. He will not laugh.
[4] ¶ In Baekje’s markets they spit when they say his title. At home they toast it. Both sides add, quietly, that Gyebek hasn’t met him yet. Until he does, “greatest blade” is a tavern argument with two right answers.
[5] [MAP 642: Forty fortresses, along a border nobody could draw the same way twice.]
[6] ¶ What reached Sabi had started a week earlier, in Surabol.
[7] ── SCENE: The Moon Palace ──
[8] Queen Sunduk: Forty, Yushin.
[9] Kim Yushin: I’ll start with one, Majesty.
[10] Queen Sunduk: Which one?
[11] Kim Yushin: One of theirs. The one they think is safest.
[12] Queen Sunduk: And the forty?
[13] Kim Yushin: Baekje has forty forts to hold now, Majesty. Forty granaries. Forty winters. / Let them feed it.
[14] Queen Sunduk: You want me to tell the court we’re letting them keep it?
[15] Kim Yushin: Tell the court I’m busy.
[16] Queen Sunduk: …That, they’ll believe.
[17] ── SCENE: The Gate ──
[18] ¶ He rides out that afternoon. The road runs past his own gate, and his household is lined up outside it, hoping. He does not turn his head. Fifty paces on he stops and sends a spearman back to the house for a cup of water.
[19] Kim Yushin: The water at home still tastes the way it used to.
[20] 🗣: He didn’t even look at the house. / …He drank the water, though.
[21] ¶ Chunchu is waiting at the city gate, as if by accident.
[22] King Muyeol: Your wife was at the gate. I saw her. / You could have stopped. One cup, inside.
[23] Kim Yushin: …If I stopped, they would invent a reason for my stopping.
[24] King Muyeol: Then don’t stop. / I’ll invent the reasons for you. I’m better at it.
[25] ── SCENE: The River Fort ──
[26] ¶ The fort sits on a bluff over a crossing, the kind of post a Baekje sentry gets sent to for a rest. Two of them are dicing by the brazier.
[27] 🗣: Silla won’t come this far. They’re busy crying over forty forts. / Throw.
[28] ¶ The other one does not throw. He is looking at the ridge. There is a pale horse on it, standing very still, and then there isn’t.
[29] ¶ An hour earlier, at the foot of the bluff, an officer had looked up at the rock and then at his general.
[30] 🗣: Sir. Nobody climbs that side.
[31] Kim Yushin: Then nobody is watching it.
[32] ¶ They go up in their socks, swords tied flat to their backs so nothing rings on the stone. Yushin goes third. Not first, which would be vanity. Not last, which would be worse.
[33] ¶ Yushin’s men come up the bluff in the dark, where nobody climbs because nobody can. By the time the brazier is kicked over they are on the wall.
[34] 🗣: K-… IT’S KIM YUSHIN!!
[35] ¶ The defence breaks before it starts. In the storehouse a young Baekje officer is trying to fire the rice before Silla can eat it. His hands shake too much for the flint.
[36] Kim Yushin: Put it down. Nobody burns anything tonight.
[37] 🗣: …You’re not going to kill me?
[38] Kim Yushin: Go home. Tell them who sent you.
[39] 🗣: Who— who do I say it was?
[40] Kim Yushin: They’ll know.
[41] ¶ It is not one of the forty. It is one of Baekje’s own, and that is the message. He has never been in a hurry about anything except a charge.
[42] ❝QUOTE (Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 41, Biographies — Kim Yushin I, Queen Seondeok yr. 13 (644)): Autumn, ninth month. The queen made him Supreme General and sent him with troops against seven Baekje fortresses, Gahye, Seongyeol, Donghwa and the rest. He won a great victory and opened the Gahye crossing.❞
[43] ── SCENE: Sabi ──
[44] ¶ The young officer comes home. He tells it the way he was told to.
[45] King Euija: He sent you home? With your sword on?
[46] 🗣: He let an officer walk out armed, Majesty. Silla’s gone soft.
[47] King Euija: Soft? He sent me a messenger with a sword on. / That’s a man saying, next time bring more.
[48] King Euija: Yushin, my friend~~ / My men stop eating at the sound of your name.
[49] King Euija: Gyebek. How many did he take?
[50] Gyebek: One, Majesty. One of ours. None of the forty.
[51] King Euija: …He isn’t taking them back. / He’s sending me the bill. / Could you beat him?
[52] Gyebek: I have not met him.
[53] King Euija: Then go and meet him.
[54] Gyebek: Not yet, Majesty. / He picked this field.
[55] ¶ Euija laughs, because it is the most honest answer anyone has given him all morning.
[56] ¶ **One star over Samhan tonight. Three men are looking up at it, and every one of them wants to be the King for All…!**
